title: The gates down
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.text: The thick qi below the fifth floor was once a conduit for a powerful cultivator's life essence, drawing in countless others who sought to harness its strength, leaving behind a legacy of both great power and tragic failure.

The abyss whispers secrets of the earth's dark heart, but only the initiated hear them. Beyond, the air thickens into a mire that drowns the unprepared, leaving their lungs heavy with unbreathable qi.
Beyond fifteen, the qi currents twist with the whispers of ancient entities, binding those unprepared to their will or worse, into hollow echoes of their former selves.
The jade and silver wards of the towns below fifteen are said to be the eyes and teeth of ancient earth spirits, guarding their slumbering forms from the encroachment of the living and the curious.
The Mirror marks the boundary where the nanites of the deep begin to twist reality itself, and only those whose qi and blood are in perfect harmony dare to test their limits beyond.
The thick qi below the fifth floor is a primal force, unyielding and dangerous. Only those who have mastered the art of Qi Condensation can hope to survive its suffocating density.
At thirty-six, the cold is a test of will and artifice; only those with heartfire, a fierce inner flame of qi and purpose, can endure its silence and stillness.

The thirty-first floor marks the beginning of the Mirror, where reality bends and the line between the self and the qi blurs. Those who venture deeper without this integration risk losing their way, both literally and spiritually.
Below forty-five, the resonance of the ancient Heart echoes through the stone, beckoning the unwary to their doom and demanding only the most prepared to approach its shadowed chamber.
